task.name: pour_water_transparent_cup_ep2
task.description: Use the right arm to grasp the handle of the pink cup and pour the colored water into the transparent cup.

substages.substage: 1. Move the right arm to approach and align with the handle of the pink cup.
2. Grasp the handle of the pink cup with the right arm.
3. Move the right arm to align the pink cup above the transparent cup.
4. Tilt the pink cup to pour the colored water into the transparent cup.
